caption: Toddler rice balls 🍙✨ Simple, filling, and perfect for little hands that want to do it all themselves 🥹 I made these with: 🥩 Ground beef 🥕 Finely chopped carrots 🌱 Frozen spinach cube 🍚 Sticky rice — I used my Korean japgokbap from @kimcmarket  ✨ Furikake from @traderjoes — since it already has some salt, I skipped any additional seasoning 🫶 A little @otoki_daily sesame oil Mix everything together, roll into bite-sized balls!  Save this for your next easy toddler meal idea! 🍙 #toddlermeals #toddlerfood #toddlermealideas #easyrecipe #toddlerdinner
